children: India will urge BRICS nations to broaden use of central bank-backed digital currencies for cross-border payments while avoiding support for a unified payments network that could be viewed as a challenge to the dollar, according to Bloomberg.
People familiar with the matter said India is pushing the digital-currency approach instead of backing a single network.

title: GEOPOLITICS | India Backs Central Bank Digital Currencies for BRICS Cross-Border Payments
